desc:
PANCAKE MIX: Pancake mix that makes fluffy, mouth-watering pancakes, waffles and more

QUICK AND EASY: Quick and easy breakfast option; just add water to pancake mix and pour onto griddle

WIN THE MORNING: This baking mix is a simple way to win over the family with delicious pancakes

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Easy to personalize with fruits, nuts or chocolate chips

CONTAINS: 6.75 oz (Pack of 9)
features:
Key Features:

Just Add Water

No need for extra ingredients like eggs or milk—perfect for quick preparation.

Classic Buttermilk Flavor

Rich, tangy buttermilk flavor for a traditional pancake or waffle taste.

Whole-Grain Enriched

Each serving includes a source of whole grains to support a balanced diet.

Versatile Use

Can be used to make both pancakes and waffles. Also great for creative recipes like muffins or savory bakes.

Shelf-Stable & Convenient

Long-lasting dry mix is ideal for pantries and on-the-go meal prep.

Benefits:

Quick & Effortless

Perfect for busy mornings—just mix with water, cook, and enjoy.

Great Taste

Produces fluffy pancakes or waffles with a satisfying, buttery flavor.

Nutrient Boost

Fortified with essential vitamins and minerals such as iron and calcium.

Family-Friendly

Easy to prepare in batches for breakfasts, brunches, or snacks.

Consistent Results

Delivers reliable texture and rise with every use.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate), Palm Oil, Whey, Dextrose, Buttermilk, Salt, DATEM.
